question.text: Which of the following INCORRECTLY pairs a passive FI benchmark with an objective?

answer.text: Low risk appetite — Low-duration + High-credit index

explanation.text: The Logic: Inflation-risk mitigation ≠ fixed-coupon long bond (which AMPLIFIES inflation risk). Per textbook: use a Floating-Rate Index or inflation-linked bonds. The Trap: Fixed-coupon long bonds lose real value to inflation — the opposite of what's needed for inflation hedging. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B Topic 19 unique. Manager's Pro-Tip: Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGBs) and inflation-linked G-Secs (IIBs) are the true inflation hedges — fold them into the FI bucket for inflation-sensitive clients.
